  Panama can be discovered on a few busy days exploring its capital and tropical forest, or on a much longer journey covering the Pacific Ocean, the Boquete highlands and Caribbean islands. Compare stops and terms to choose the right depth of experience rather than judging a trip solely by its duration or the word VIP.

## Choosing a Panama tour: city, jungle, islands or multiple countries

Our catalog includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. **Begin with three questions:** how much time do you have for Panama, do you want time at the seaside, and would you like to visit neighboring countries? Short itineraries are suitable for discovering the canal and nature near the capital. For Panama's mountains, coffee and both coastlines, allow more time. [Multi-country programs](/multi-country/) serve a different purpose: they combine Panama with Costa Rica and other neighbors, so not every day is devoted to Panama itself.

For example, the [6-day “Panama City and Gamboa” itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) combines the historic center, [Miraflores Locks](/panama/place/miraflores-locks/), encounters with an Emberá community, [Gamboa](/panama/place/gamboa/) and a boat trip on [Gatún Lake](/panama/place/gatun-lake/). The [7-day “All of Panama”](/panama/tour/panama-national-parks-islands-valleys/) adds Taboga Island, San Lorenzo Fortress and Antón Valley. Both travel within Panama, but their nature and historical stops differ.

| Option | Main focus |
|---|---|
| [4 days: city and history](/panama/tour/panama-city-anton-valley-san-lorenzo/) | Canal, Antón Valley, fortress |
| [6 days: Panama and Gamboa](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) | Forest, Emberá, Gatún, capital |
| [7 days: all of Panama](/panama/tour/panama-national-parks-islands-valleys/) | Parks, Taboga, Caribbean coast |
| [12 days: Panama and islands](/panama/tour/luxury-panama-12-days/) | Boca Chica, Boquete, Bocas del Toro |
| [San Blas yacht](/panama/tour/panama-san-blas-luxury-yacht/) | Sailing among islands |
| [Panama + Costa Rica](/multi-country/tour/panama-costa-rica/) | Excursions in two countries |

These are different products with their own day-by-day sequences, included services and accommodation terms. Straight-line distances on a map do not show how long transfers between mainland and island regions of Panama take.

## Short tours: when the capital and its surroundings are enough

### Panama City, the canal and historic districts

For travelers with limited time, the [4-day Panama itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-city-anton-valley-san-lorenzo/) connects [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/), [Antón Valley](/panama/place/el-valle-de-anton/) and [San Lorenzo Fortress](/panama/place/san-lorenzo-fort/). It is a sightseeing route in which most time is spent in the city, on history and on excursions. It does not provide for several nights on distant islands.

In the capital, three different subjects are worth comparing: the colonial streets of [Casco Viejo](/panama/place/casco-viejo/), the exhibitions at the [Biomuseo](/panama/place/biomuseo/) and the operation of the [Panama Canal](/panama/place/panama-canal/). One city tour can cover several such sites, but the exact selection and admission tickets come from the individual itinerary. For a more detailed introduction, consider the [Miraflores – Biomuseo – Casco Viejo tour](/panama/panama-city/panama-miraflores-biomuseo-casco-viejo/).

Visiting the locks depends on the operation of the visitor centers. Infrastructure changes are taking place at Miraflores, so it is important to check the availability of the center, visiting arrangements and possible alternatives separately before traveling. The words “Panama Canal” in a tour indicate a scheduled stop, not a guarantee that every viewing hall, exhibition or specific area will be open on your chosen date.

### Six days: Gamboa forest and Gatún Lake

The [6-day “Panama City and Gamboa” journey](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) begins with several days in the capital. The route then passes through [Chagres](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/), with a visit to an Emberá community and canoe travel along the river, and continues to [Gamboa](/panama/place/gamboa/).

Gamboa provides a base for nature excursions in [Soberanía National Park](/panama/place/soberania-national-park/) and the [Panama Rainforest Discovery Center](/panama/place/panama-rainforest-discovery-center/). A boat trip on [Gatún Lake](/panama/place/gatun-lake/) toward [Monkey Island](/panama/place/monkey-island-gatun/) is included. Seeing particular animals depends on nature: observation is the purpose of the outing, not a guarantee of an encounter.

This itinerary offers accommodation options with different hotel categories in the capital and different room occupancy types. Whether certain lunches are included and the guide's language are agreed when booking. It is the content of the fare, rather than the headline price alone, that allows a fair comparison with other offers.

## Seven days in Panama: adding an island, river and valley

[“All of Panama: National Parks, Islands and Valleys”](/panama/tour/panama-national-parks-islands-valleys/) lasts 7 days. It includes a visit to [Chagres National Park](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/) and an Emberá community, a separate day on [Taboga Island](/panama/place/taboga-island/), an outing to [Soberanía](/panama/place/soberania-national-park/) and [Gatún Lake](/panama/place/gatun-lake/), a visit to [San Lorenzo Fortress](/panama/place/san-lorenzo-fort/) and the [Agua Clara Locks](/panama/place/agua-clara-locks/). One day is dedicated to [El Valle de Antón](/panama/place/el-valle-de-anton/).

The difference from the six-day itinerary is the variety of day trips out of the capital, rather than numerous additional hotel stays around the country. Taboga adds a short marine stage, but it is not equivalent to visiting [San Blas](/panama/place/san-blas-islands/) or [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/). If your main goal is several days on an island without excursions, consider a longer route with beach stops.

When planning this week, check the excursion order. Some sightseeing days may be rearranged, while opportunities to observe passing ships and aquatic animals depend on conditions. Decide in advance which experiences matter most to you: the canal, local communities, forests or swimming.

## Twelve days: Panama from the Pacific to the Caribbean

The [12-day Panama itinerary](/panama/tour/luxury-panama-12-days/) begins in the capital, passes through [Gatún](/panama/place/gatun-lake/) and [Chagres](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/), then takes visitors to the Pacific coast near [Boca Chica](/panama/place/boca-chica/). A domestic Panama City–David flight and several days on a private island are scheduled. This is a different pace: free days beside the sea alternate with excursions.

The next section leads to [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/) and [Barú Volcano](/panama/place/baru-volcano/). A coffee plantation and mountain program are included, followed by travel to [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/) on the Caribbean coast. The route also includes a return flight to Panama City. Check the flight sequence and hotel conditions before making a final selection.

**This tour suits travelers who value changing scenery and different forms of relaxation:** the capital, tropical forest, ocean island, mountains and Caribbean archipelago. Staying at a seaside hotel and taking a yacht trip are different products. The word “luxury” does not mean that every transfer, excursion or leisure activity is privately arranged; the confirmed services are listed on that tour's page.

## San Blas Islands: when a yacht voyage is what you want

The [separate San Blas yacht tour](/panama/tour/panama-san-blas-luxury-yacht/) is a marine journey. Its eight-day itinerary passes through [Flamenco](/panama/place/flamenco-island/), [Shelter Bay](/panama/place/shelter-bay/), [Porvenir](/panama/place/el-porvenir-island/), [Coco Bandero](/panama/place/coco-bandero-island/), the [Holandes Cays](/panama/place/holandes-cays/), [Isla Perro](/panama/place/isla-perro/) and [Turtle Island](/panama/place/turtle-island/). It is a sequence of stops on the water, not a land-based sightseeing tour of Panama.

The archipelago lies within Guna Yala, where communities and islands have their own visiting rules. Mooring arrangements, weather, port operations and the list of inclusions must be checked against the specific yacht offer. Its price cannot be compared with an ordinary hotel tour's per-person rate without first confirming the pricing basis.

If you want a single island day as part of a broader country tour, a multi-day yacht voyage is not necessary. First decide what matters most: sleeping aboard, beaches and snorkeling, or a city and nature sightseeing route.

## Panama and neighboring countries: when to combine itineraries

The [“Panama and Costa Rica” tour](/multi-country/tour/panama-costa-rica/) begins in [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/) and [Chagres](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/), then turns to Costa Rica's volcanoes and cloud forests. It finishes on the Pacific coast at Manuel Antonio. This option suits travelers who want to compare Panama's cultural and historical attractions with a neighboring country's nature program.

[“Panama – Costa Rica – Nicaragua”](/multi-country/tour/panama-costa-rica-nicaragua/) adds Granada and Masaya Volcano in Nicaragua. [“The Best of Central America”](/multi-country/tour/best-of-central-america/) covers six countries including Panama. Such journeys involve more border crossings and transport, so check how many sightseeing days are actually spent in Panama. For an in-depth visit to [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/) and [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/), a multi-country itinerary only works if those stops appear explicitly in its day-by-day program.

## When to go and how to assess transport logistics

On Panama's Pacific side, the generally drier season runs from December to April, with the rainy season from May to November. The Caribbean coast can have rainfall throughout the year, and conditions are not identical to those around Panama City. Check a plan involving beaches, yachts and boat excursions against weather for the **specific islands and dates**, not merely a forecast for the capital.

The canal area, national parks and [Gamboa](/panama/place/gamboa/) combine conveniently into one route section. Travel logistics are more involved for [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/), [Boca Chica](/panama/place/boca-chica/) and [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/): flights and connections become part of the trip. Domestic flights are specifically mentioned in the 12-day program; their inclusion in other tours must not be assumed automatically.

Compare prices on the same accommodation and service basis. The [six-day itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) has SGL, DBL and TRP variants and several hotel categories. The [yacht program](/panama/tour/panama-san-blas-luxury-yacht/) is a different kind of product, with a pricing basis that needs separate confirmation. If a listing states one amount without adequate explanation, it does not necessarily indicate the cost for each group member.

## Frequently asked questions about Panama tours

### Can we see the canal and jungle on one trip without domestic flights?

Yes. The [six-day Panama City and Gamboa itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) combines the capital, [Soberanía](/panama/place/soberania-national-park/), [Chagres](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/) and Gatún Lake. It does not require traveling to remote island regions; transfers and excursions are detailed on the tour page.

### Which tour should we choose for a first visit to Panama?

With four days, consider the [short route through the capital and Antón Valley](/panama/tour/panama-city-anton-valley-san-lorenzo/). If you have a week, compare the [six-day Gamboa option](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) and [seven-day Taboga and San Lorenzo itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-national-parks-islands-valleys/). Their included sightseeing differs.

### Is there a tour combining coffee, mountains and relaxation on both coasts?

Yes. All these stages are featured in the [12-day program](/panama/tour/luxury-panama-12-days/): Boca Chica, [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/), the [Barú region](/panama/place/baru-volcano/) and [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/). See the [coffee tours section](/interests/coffee-tours/) for the culture of coffee cultivation and specialist trips; the chosen Panama tour determines the actual stops.

### Is a visit to Miraflores Locks included?

That depends on the specific itinerary and the visitor center's operating arrangements on your travel date. For example, the [six-day tour](/panama/tour/panama-city-gamboa-6-days/) schedules a stop at Miraflores, but the actual form of the visit should be confirmed in light of current infrastructure work.

### How is a San Blas tour different from a day on Taboga Island?

The [San Blas yacht voyage](/panama/tour/panama-san-blas-luxury-yacht/) involves sailing successively between islands. In the [seven-day Panama tour](/panama/tour/panama-national-parks-islands-valleys/), [Taboga](/panama/place/taboga-island/) is a single day stop among several other excursions.

## Premium Panama in 12 days: two coasts, an island and mountains

The [12-day premium Panama tour](/panama/tour/luxury-panama-12-days/) connects historic [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/), natural areas near the Panama Canal, Pacific-coast [Boca Chica](/panama/place/boca-chica/), mountain [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/) and Caribbean [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/).

A key distinction in the itinerary is between **the island stay near Boca Chica and Barú Volcano**. Boca Chica is on the Pacific side; Barú is a high volcanic mountain visited later from Boquete. These are different locations and different days. The final section of the journey offers relaxation on the Caribbean Sea.

## The capital, Panama Canal and Emberá community

The first three days take place in and around the capital. They include the historic district of Casco Antiguo, an introduction to the Panama Canal, [Gatún Lake](/panama/place/gatun-lake/) and [San Lorenzo Fortress](/panama/place/san-lorenzo-fort/). A visit to [Chagres National Park](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/) and an Emberá community is also scheduled.

On the water, travelers may observe monkeys and birds near forested banks while ships pass through another part of the lake. Sighting a particular animal depends on nature. San Lorenzo Fortress is part of Panama's UNESCO-recognized Spanish Caribbean fortification system.

The first three days include guiding, with **Russian available upon request**. Confirm this in advance; the premium positioning alone does not guarantee a Russian-speaking guide throughout every stage.

## A private-island stay near Boca Chica

Day four includes a Panama City–[David](/panama/place/david/) flight and transfer to [Boca Chica](/panama/place/boca-chica/). Island accommodation is planned at Cala Mia Island Resort on a private island.

**Days five and six are set aside for relaxation.** Possible activities include walks on ecological trails, kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, yoga and beach time. Check the availability and cost of extra activities against the booked accommodation's terms: a hotel's list of possibilities is not always the list of paid inclusions.

The island section specifies breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner. Drinks are mentioned too, but the exact meal and beverage plan needs confirmation for the chosen tariff.

## Boquete: Geisha coffee and Barú Volcano

After the island stay, the itinerary continues to [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/). Accommodation is planned at Panamonte Inn & Spa, with a visit to a coffee plantation producing Geisha coffee.

The following morning starts early: a **4:30 AM departure by off-road vehicle for Barú Volcano** is scheduled. [Barú](/panama/place/baru-volcano/) is the highest point in Panama. In clear weather, views from its summit may extend toward both ocean coastlines, but visibility depends on clouds.

The mountain stage has different temperatures and weather from the island stay: warm clothes and suitable shoes are more important here than beach accessories. Hanging bridges among the cloud forest are scheduled for the afternoon.

## Bocas del Toro: a Caribbean conclusion

After Boquete, the route heads to [Bocas del Toro](/panama/place/bocas-del-toro/), with accommodation at Azul Paradise Bastimentos Island Punta Vieja. Day nine includes a journey to the archipelago and boat transfers, while day ten is completely free.

The archipelago is known for beaches, coral reefs and mangrove lagoons. Snorkeling and boat trips may be possible depending on chosen activities; marine wildlife can be seen in nature but sightings cannot be guaranteed.

Day eleven includes a domestic Bocas del Toro–Panama City flight and accommodation at The Bristol Panama. Day twelve is an airport transfer and the end of the tour.

## What's included and how this tour differs

Published inclusions cover private transfers, hotel accommodation as specified, excursions, meals by day and **two domestic flights**: Panama City–David and Bocas del Toro–Panama City. International tickets, extra activities, airport taxes, personal expenses and tips are listed separately as exclusions.

| Comparison | Difference |
|---|---|
| [7 days in Panama](/panama/tour/panama-national-parks-islands-valleys/) | Excursions around the capital |
| [11 days in Panama](/panama/tour/best-of-panama-2023/) | Mountains and the Caribbean |
| 12 days premium | Extra time on a Pacific private island |

Choose this option by comparing the confirmed hotels, meals, private transport, domestic flights and number of days without compulsory excursions, rather than an abstract VIP label. Specific room types and final accommodation terms are agreed for the selected program.

## Frequently asked questions about the premium Panama tour

### Where is the beach relaxation?

Two free days are set aside on a private island near Pacific Boca Chica; later there is one free day in the Caribbean Bocas del Toro archipelago.

### Is Barú an island?

No. In this itinerary, Barú is a volcano near Boquete. The Pacific private-island stay occurs earlier, near Boca Chica.

### Which domestic flights are included?

Panama City–David and Bocas del Toro–Panama City.

### Is a Russian-speaking guide included?

Russian-language guiding is offered upon request. Its availability and duration must be specified in the booking terms.

## Panama in 16 days: from the Panama Canal to two ocean coasts

On this journey, Panama reveals very different landscapes: a modern capital, historic Caribbean fortifications, tropical rivers, mountains and beaches. The itinerary first introduces [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/), then heads west toward [Boca Chica](/panama/place/boca-chica/) and [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/). After the highlands, travelers reach islands on the Caribbean coast.

**Duration: 16 days.** This option is for people who want to see Pacific and Caribbean landscapes on one trip and reserve several days for relaxation. Unlike the [short itinerary through Panama City and Antón Valley](/panama/tour/panama-city-anton-valley-san-lorenzo/), it includes domestic flights, a long mountain-road journey and separate beach days.

## How the regions change along the route

| Days | Main section |
|---|---|
| 1–5 | Capital, canal, Chagres, San Blas |
| 6–8 | Pacific Boca Chica |
| 9–11 | Boquete highlands and Barú Volcano |
| 12–14 | Caribbean islands |
| 15–16 | Return to Panama City |

The first five days combine sightseeing in the capital's historic districts with outings into nature. The program includes Miraflores Locks, Casco Antiguo, city walks and an introduction to the Panama Canal. Visitors can watch ships passing through the locks from observation areas. The Canal Authority separately develops visitor centers on the Pacific and Caribbean sides; the time at which a particular ship passes, however, follows traffic schedules rather than the tour group's wishes.

Day three includes a trip to [Chagres National Park](/panama/place/chagres-national-park/) with a river section and a visit to an Emberá community. Travelers learn about crafts and local culture. Since this is a visit to a real community, photography, purchases and personal interaction should respect local customs and permissions.

## San Blas and historic fortresses: two different days

Day four starts with an early departure for the [San Blas archipelago](/panama/place/san-blas-islands/) and a return to the hotel that evening. Time on Caribbean beaches is scheduled. **This is a day trip**, not a week-long yacht cruise with nights aboard. A different itinerary and conditions apply to the separate [San Blas yacht tour](/panama/tour/panama-san-blas-luxury-yacht/).

Day five is dedicated to fortifications along the Caribbean shore. Stops include [San Lorenzo Fortress](/panama/place/san-lorenzo-fort/) near the mouth of the Chagres River. Together with Portobelo's fortifications, it forms a UNESCO World Heritage property dedicated to Spain's defensive system on Panama's Atlantic coast. The sites help explain the transport of goods between oceans long before the modern canal was built.

## Boca Chica: relaxing on the Pacific side

On day six, after a visit to the Biomuseo, the group heads to Albrook airport, flies to David and continues to Boca Chica. Days seven and eight are free for relaxation beside the Pacific Ocean. Travelers can spend time by the sea or choose an **optional** boat trip to small islands. Distinguish these outings from compulsory transport: they are possibilities on free days, not guaranteed inclusions in every program.

This stage offers a break after early starts in the capital. The Pacific coast differs from the Caribbean islands visited later, allowing travelers to compare the two coasts through the actual travel experience rather than advertising photographs.

## Boquete: volcano, mountain forest and coffee

Day nine takes the route to mountainous [Boquete](/panama/place/boquete/). Day ten begins very early: departure is scheduled around 4 AM, with a 4×4 off-road ascent toward [Barú Volcano](/panama/place/baru-volcano/) to roughly 3,475 m. In clear weather, views from the summit extend toward both oceans. This depends on clouds; simultaneous visibility of the Pacific and Caribbean cannot be guaranteed.

Day eleven brings canopy adventure above mountain forest and a visit to a coffee plantation with a Geisha coffee tasting. This itinerary genuinely includes a substantial food-and-drink experience connected with growing and tasting coffee, not merely a cup served at breakfast.

The mountains require different clothing from the beaches. Bring a warm outer layer, comfortable shoes and rain protection for the early drive. Travelers sensitive to altitude should discuss the outing with the organizers and consider their individual limitations.

## Bocas del Toro and returning to the capital

Day twelve involves a drive from Boquete across the mountains to Almirante and then a water taxi to the Bocas del Toro islands. Days thirteen and fourteen are free for island relaxation. On day fifteen, travelers fly to Panama City, and on day sixteen they transfer to the airport.

Connections between different types of transport are particularly important here: car, domestic plane and water taxi. Although some transfers are specified in the tour's day-by-day schedule, ticket conditions and the availability of actual services need confirmation against the agreed program.

## What's included and which costs are separate

The package includes transfers, accommodation at the named hotels or equivalents with breakfast, excursions with Russian- or English-speaking guides and an admission ticket to the Panama Canal. Exclusions list international airfare, extra excursions, airport taxes, additional meals, beverages, tips, personal expenses and laundry services.

It is important to distinguish **a described form of transport** from **an airline ticket paid for in the package**. The itinerary contains domestic flights between regions, but air tickets are not explicitly listed among the included services. Their payment terms must be agreed separately; neither domestic nor international airfare can automatically be added to the package based on the general word “transfers.”

## Frequently asked questions about the extended Panama tour

### Can we see both coasts on one journey?

Yes. The program includes Pacific Boca Chica and the Caribbean islands in the country's northwest, plus a separate early day trip to San Blas from the capital.

### Are all island outings included?

No. The day on San Blas is part of the main itinerary, but boat trips to islands near Boca Chica are optional activities on free days.

### Do we need special mountain training?

The itinerary does not describe a multi-day climb on foot: Barú is approached by off-road vehicle. However, the altitude, very early start and mountain weather call for preparation.

### Are there free days?

Yes. Free time is scheduled at Boca Chica and Bocas del Toro. This distinguishes the itinerary from routes where every day is filled with transfers and excursions.

### Is this suitable for a brief visit?

No. The tour lasts 16 days and includes several remote regions. For an initial visit focusing on the capital, canal and nearby nature, compare the [four-day itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-city-anton-valley-san-lorenzo/).

## Panama in 4 days: Panama City, Antón Valley and San Lorenzo Fortress

A short journey can combine the history of the capital, the natural landscape within an ancient volcanic caldera and the Atlantic side of the Panama Canal. This route is for travelers with **4 days and 3 nights** who want a substantial introduction to the country without flights to distant islands or changing hotels between regions.

The main places are [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/), [El Valle de Antón](/panama/place/el-valle-de-anton/), [San Lorenzo Fortress](/panama/place/san-lorenzo-fort/) and the [Agua Clara Locks](/panama/place/agua-clara-locks/). The program includes private vehicle transfers, Russian-guided sightseeing and time to relax independently after arrival.

## Day-by-day itinerary

| Day | Main journey |
|---|---|
| 1 | Arrival and hotel check-in in the capital |
| 2 | El Valle de Antón |
| 3 | San Lorenzo and Agua Clara Locks |
| 4 | Historic Panama City |

On day one, after arrival at Tocumen Airport, a Russian-speaking guide meets guests for the transfer and check-in at the chosen hotel. Day two is a full excursion lasting **about 8 hours**. Day three heads to the Caribbean side, while day four has a **6-hour** city tour.

This schedule suits an introductory visit, but must be coordinated with the international flight departure: the last day is busy, and an early flight could leave too little time for the historic center.

## Antón Valley: a town inside a volcanic caldera

Day two is dedicated to [El Valle de Antón](/panama/place/el-valle-de-anton/), nestled among green slopes inside an ancient volcanic caldera. Instead of the capital's buildings, there are small neighborhoods, mountains and a local market selling fruit, plants and crafts.

A visit to [Chorro del Macho Waterfall](/panama/place/chorro-del-macho-waterfall/) is included. There are nature trails nearby; canopy activities over the waterfall are an **optional paid extra**. Visiting the valley does not automatically include a paid canopy tour. Travelers wanting to add one must agree the time and separate terms.

At the market you can see local produce, souvenirs and handicrafts. Visit for a glimpse of the region's daily life, not expecting a huge shopping center. The eight-hour day involves travel, walks and stops, so comfortable shoes and rain protection are more practical than formal city clothes.

## San Lorenzo Fortress: history on the Caribbean coast

Day three begins with an early departure to the Atlantic side. [San Lorenzo](/panama/place/san-lorenzo-fort/) stands above the coast near the mouth of the Chagres River. It formed part of the historic defense system used by the Spanish crown to protect routes between the Atlantic and Pacific.

San Lorenzo and Portobelo's fortifications are part of a UNESCO World Heritage property. Pay attention not only to surviving walls and bastions but also to geography: the fort's position allowed control over seaward approaches to the river mouth. The location was strategically important long before the modern Panama Canal.

A small historical detail: the first fortifications at the Chagres mouth were built in the 16th century and were rebuilt several times. Panama's Ministry of Culture describes the site as a historical monument and provides information on its protection.

## Agua Clara: how the expanded canal works

After the fortress, the route goes to the [Agua Clara Locks](/panama/place/agua-clara-locks/) on the canal's Caribbean side. Its visitor center offers a view of the engineering works and the movement of large vessels. Unlike visiting Miraflores on the Pacific side, the focus here is on the expanded canal infrastructure and the approaches to Gatún Lake.

The Panama Canal Authority operates separate visitor facilities at Agua Clara and Miraflores. Seeing a specific ship transit depends on traffic schedules. It is better to arrange the excursion timetable in advance than to hinge the whole day on a particular vessel's passage.

Russian-language guiding is included on day three, but **lunch is excluded from the price**. This is an important practical detail on a long day involving road transfers.

## Panamá Viejo and Casco Antiguo: different eras of the same capital

Day four features a city tour of [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/): the Panamá Viejo archaeological park, historic Casco Antiguo, the former Canal Zone and Balboa Avenue.

The two historic districts tell different chapters: Panamá Viejo preserves ruins of the original Spanish city, while Casco Antiguo grew after the center was moved in the 17th century. Together they constitute the UNESCO World Heritage property “Archaeological Site of Panamá Viejo and Historic District of Panamá.” This connection makes it possible to see the city as a sequence of history rather than a collection of separate cathedrals and squares.

The six-hour tour includes admission to the archaeological park; that ticket is covered by the price. An admission ticket to the Panama Canal is also specified. **Lunch during the city tour is paid for separately**, as on the previous two excursion days.

## What's included in the four-day tour

The package includes taxes, airport–hotel transfers, **three nights' accommodation with breakfast**, private comfortable transport, Russian-language excursions to Antón Valley, San Lorenzo and Agua Clara, and a Panama City sightseeing tour. Admissions to the Panama Canal and Panamá Viejo archaeological park are covered.

**Lunches on all three excursion days are excluded.** Canopy in Antón Valley costs extra. Ada Tours may replace a hotel with one of the same category if necessary, or adjust the excursion order while preserving the program.

This tour is especially convenient for travelers who prefer one hotel base and want to understand the geography of the Panamanian isthmus. For both coasts, Barú Volcano and island relaxation, compare the [longer 16-day Panama itinerary](/panama/tour/panama-2024/).

### Are excursions guided in Russian?

Yes. Russian-language guiding is provided for El Valle de Antón, San Lorenzo, Agua Clara and the capital's city tour.

### Do we need to change hotels between excursions?

The program includes three nights in the selected hotel, with trips around the area and returns. No move to another city for a permanent stay is needed.

Yes. An admission ticket for the canal and one for the Panamá Viejo archaeological park appear among the inclusions.

No. Lunches on the Antón Valley day, at the fortress and locks, and during the historic city tour are excluded from the price.

Yes, as a separate paid option. The main eight-hour tour includes the valley and its natural sights; canopy requires additional arrangements.

## Panama City and Gamboa in 6 days: canal, forest and Emberá culture

**This itinerary combines an introduction to the Panama Canal with several days among tropical forest.** Over six days there are five nights: three in [Panama City](/panama/place/panama-city/) and two in [Gamboa](/panama/place/gamboa/). The city section includes the locks, Biomuseo and historic architecture. The nature section explores the Chagres River, the forests of Soberanía National Park and Gatún Lake.

This program suits travelers who want both history and nature without changing countries. Most full days are devoted to excursions; no standalone beach holiday is scheduled. The transfer to Gamboa is part of the cultural visit to an Emberá community, and the return to the capital follows a boat trip.

## The six-day itinerary

| Day | Main activity |
|---|---|
| 1 | Arrival in the capital |
| 2 | Canal and old town |
| 3 | Chagres and an Emberá community |
| 4 | Soberanía and a forest observation tower |
| 5 | Gatún Lake |
| 6 | Departure flight |

The first two nights are in Panama City. On day three, after visiting the Emberá community, travelers transfer to Gamboa and stay at Gamboa Rainforest Resort. The following day brings forest trails and an observation tower. After the boat day on Gatún, the group returns to Panama City for the final night.

Time for independent walks in the capital depends on arrival and departure flights. If you want to explore local museums, evening neighborhoods and modern architecture at length, the basic six days are quite full: any spare hours must be coordinated with the excursion timetable.

## Miraflores Locks: what's interesting about the canal

The second part of the initial city stage is dedicated to Miraflores Locks, the Biomuseo and historic Casco Viejo. At Miraflores, visitors can discover how the Panama Canal works: a ship moves between water levels as lock chambers fill and empty. This is a visible example of an engineering system that transformed sea transport.

**Visiting the locks does not mean sailing through the whole canal aboard a ship.** The itinerary includes a Miraflores visit; a separate cruise or transit through all locks on a passenger vessel is not included. If that is your particular goal, you need a distinct program with a confirmed water route.

Old Casco Viejo reveals another side of Panama City: historic buildings, squares and urban life. The Biomuseo links the capital's attractions to the nature of the Panamanian isthmus before the onward forest section.

## A day on the Chagres and meeting the Emberá

On day three, the program includes canoe travel on the Chagres River, a visit to an Emberá community and a cultural experience. After lunch, the route continues to [Gamboa](/panama/place/gamboa/). The day has several distinct elements: river transport, an introduction to local traditions and a transfer to another hotel.

The particular community, visit length and group size are not fixed in advance in the approved itinerary. These details are confirmed at booking. This cultural encounter should be treated as meeting a living community rather than a staged museum show with an identical guaranteed script. Respecting local rules and asking permission before photographing people is especially important.

The day finishes near the rainforest. This sequence is convenient because travelers do not need to set out from the capital for a distant nature excursion the next morning and then return to the city.

## Soberanía: forest trails and observation tower

Day four is devoted to Soberanía National Park and the Panama Rainforest Discovery Center. Visitors follow trails and climb an observation tower for a different perspective on the forest—the treetops, which cannot be seen in the same way from ground level. This change of viewing height makes the day particularly appealing for photographers and birdwatchers.

**No one can guarantee that a particular animal will appear near a trail.** Weather, time of day and group noise all affect sightings. Binoculars, comfortable footwear and rain protection are useful; a telephoto lens helps when photographing birds.

Staying overnight in Gamboa provides more time in this natural area. However, additional hotel amenities are not necessarily included in the tour: the compulsory package is determined by the listed excursions and services.

## Gatún Lake and Monkey Island

On day five, the group departs Gamboa for a boat excursion on Gatún Lake toward the Monkey Island area. The water-based experience complements the walking day in Soberanía: travelers see forested banks and animal habitats from another perspective. Return to Panama City is scheduled after lunch or in the afternoon.

The name Monkey Island refers to a natural attraction, **but it does not guarantee seeing monkeys at a predetermined time**. Wildlife observation depends on natural conditions. For travelers primarily interested in nature, the combination of forest trails and a boat excursion is the most substantial part of this itinerary.

The scheduled activity is a sightseeing boat trip on the lake. Staying overnight on the island, a special safari or feeding animals are not specified among included services.

In the capital, travelers may choose 4-star or 5-star accommodation; both options include two nights at Gamboa Rainforest Resort. The 4-star/5-star designation in the tariff table refers to the capital's hotel options, not automatically to every hotel on the route. Prices vary by SGL, DBL and TRP occupancy.

The package includes five nights, breakfasts, excursions and admission tickets according to the program, and ground transfers. An English-speaking guide is part of the basic service; Russian- and Portuguese-language options require separate confirmation with the tariff. Private airport transfers do not mean every river excursion or group activity is also private.

Some individual days mention lunches, but the tariff table is marked BB. **All five breakfasts are confirmed; whether lunches are included and who pays for them must be agreed when booking.** Dinners are not promised in the general day-by-day program. Extra activities, personal spending and specified airport taxes are charged separately.

Two nights. The other three are in Panama City, including the last night before departure.
